title: Artwork naming protocol
slide_intent: Show how an asset name can help a designer identify the intended program, lockup and reproduction version before opening the file.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can support distributed teams with predictable filenames that distinguish visually similar master artworks.
demonstration: An example filename runs across a blue panel. Brackets connect its segments to labels and lists of available program, asset, orientation, color and format codes.
practical_value: Parse the sample name into fields and use the same order to select a program-specific artwork with the needed ink and file format.

content_islands.spec: Place the instruction for master artworks in the left rail.

content_islands.name: Annotated filename
content_islands.spec: Place the full example on a white strip within the pale blue panel. Connect each segment by brackets to its meaning above or below.
